action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Append exactly one line to the end of docs/kiro-journal.md in the form "- YYYY-MM-DD | <Kiro feature> | <description>", using today's date. The Kiro feature is one of Specs, Steering, Hooks, Agent, Property-based testing or similar. The description is at most 2 sentences saying which Kiro feature was used and how. Do not use the | character inside the feature or description. Do not change any other line.
